name: Superseded and deprecated identifier mappings
description: Withdrawn standards, deprecated API models and retired identifiers mapped to their named successors. Answers 'what replaced X' when X is a standards document reference or an API model identifier — the exact lookup that assistants get confidently wrong on obscure designations.
